rows.quote: METHODS: We conducted two-sample MR using protein quantitative trait loci from 54,219 UK Biobank participants and summary-level association results from up to 11,114 EOS cases (onset <60 years) and 435,540 controls in the Early-Onset Stroke Consortium.
rows.coder_note: Sentence names the Early-Onset Stroke Consortium summary results as the outcome dataset; the dictionary has no row for it.
